method: Theil–Sen flat-bottom baseline slopes and median caplines. One uniform scale per physical source page; independent row baselines; no individual glyph-height normalization.

regular-14-n.note: Figures share the physical printed line with capitals. Preserve their unequal heights and descenders.

regular-14-census-n.note: Independent baseline for the distant right-hand numeral block on the gently bowed source line. Baseline figures 1/2/3/6/8/0 agree within 0.24 native pixel; descending 4/5/7 and the pointed 9 are excluded as anchors. All ten figures keep their source-relative positions at the same physical page scale.
